_comment: #347 prototype demo: a run that talked its way through everything. Stands in the leased room facing the bed, so the FIRST interact is the sleep that logs a system-bestowal candidate (WI_SYSTEM_BESTOWAL_LOG=1 / --system-bestowal-log=1 -- with the flag off this save is an ordinary quiet night). The portfolio is the spec's pacifist shape: three peaceful resolutions banked (goblins_spared, resolved_wrong_order, mediated_the_debt), persuaded_someone 2 + heard_gossip 3 behind the held Diplomat, and won_combat 2 -- at the absence arm's ceiling, not under it, so the demo also proves the boundary is inclusive. Classes are honest: warrior 2 (sparred_with_relc + won_combat 1 for L2, melee_hit 5 keeps L3's 6 out of reach), helper 1 (cleaned_the_inn 1, its L2 needs 3), diplomat 1 (its own gained_by exactly met, L2 needs heard_gossip 5). Nothing here trips a class gain, level, evolution or consolidation, so the sleep's only new line IS the candidate log. rng_state derived from seed 347 via tests/_derive_rng_state.gd.
